facts.business: National Fittings Limited manufactures and sells specialised grooved piping products and pipe fittings for domestic and export markets.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on Property, plant and equipment

key_risks: Geopolitical developments in the Middle East affecting project execution, customer purchasing decisions, logistics and freight costs
Changes in tariff policies and global trade dynamics altering competitive conditions in export markets
Foreign exchange rate fluctuations impacting export-oriented business
Raw material supply chain risks for castings, a principal raw material input
facts.related_party_note: The Company has a policy for related party transactions; schedule of related party transactions during the year and balances at year-end were obtained and read; minutes of audit committee meeting wherein such transactions were pre-approved were reviewed.
